# Every host the Agent's own installers download from (install_*.go, node_install.go,
# jdk*.go, internal/jdkvendor), redirect hops included. Settings > Toolchains and the
# boot-time installs run them, so on an enforcing egress gateway a host missing from the
# Control Plane's default allowlist breaks a product button with nothing pointing at the
# cause.
#
# Two tests read this file, one per Go module:
#   workspace/agent  installer_egress_hosts_test.go: every https:// host in those sources
#                    is listed here; a listed host found in none of them must say
#                    "redirect" in its comment.
#   control-plane    egress_installer_hosts_test.go: defaultEgressAllowlist admits every
#                    plain line and does NOT admit any "!" line.
#
# A "!" line is a host the product needs but deliberately leaves to the admin: a
# general-purpose storage endpoint anyone can upload to, which a builtin entry would stop
# the admin from blocking. The operator guide's egress section names these.
#
# Format: one host per line, optional "!" prefix, optional "# comment".

# JDK
api.adoptium.net
github.com                          # redirect: Adoptium binary link -> GitHub release
release-assets.githubusercontent.com # redirect: GitHub release -> asset storage
corretto.aws

# Node.js, Go, gcloud
nodejs.org
go.dev
dl.google.com                       # gcloud archive; also the redirect target of go.dev/dl

# databases
cdn.mysql.com
repo1.maven.org                     # embedded Postgres (zonky)
deb.debian.org                      # Postgres client packages

# agent CLIs
prod.download.cli.kiro.dev
lookaside.facebook.com              # muse CLI artifacts
awscli.amazonaws.com
s3.amazonaws.com                    # session-manager-plugin

# Chromium and its fonts
cdn.playwright.dev
playwright.download.prss.microsoft.com
!storage.googleapis.com             # x64 Chrome for Testing; cdn.playwright.dev redirects here too
raw.githubusercontent.com           # Noto CJK font
